The rep never lost the customer, but the bill-collection section ran long without a deliberate protocol pivot, and several scripted anchors (bill flip, no-driving/computer instruction, verbal handshake) were skipped entirely.

This is the single largest time-efficiency gap on the call and a repeatable coaching pattern for any low-tech customer.

Customer gives a summertime bill estimate of ~$100, and the rep acknowledges with 'Perfect' but never flips this into emotional alignment-against-the-utility before moving to the credit qualifier. Capture happened; the flip did not.

key_moments.quote: Now now I'm looking on Google Maps. Beautiful home, by the way. Lots of sun exposure, which is always good to see.
key_moments.stewart_read: A well-placed personalized compliment right after the confused opening, using a specific detail (sun exposure) rather than generic flattery. This helps re-anchor a customer who just said she didn't remember filling out a form.
